title: Bulk Core Web Vitals Checker – Lighthouse Audit
description: Run Lighthouse audits on a list of URLs and get Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, TBT, FCP), Speed Index and the four Lighthouse category scores for each page.

urls.title: URLs to audit
urls.description: One URL per line (http or https). You can also load URLs from a dataset below, for example the output of a sitemap extractor.

urlsDataset.title: Load URLs from a dataset (optional)
urlsDataset.description: Pick one of your datasets. The Actor gets read-only access to this dataset only.

urlsDatasetField.title: URL field in the dataset
urlsDatasetField.description: Name of the field that holds the URL.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs per run
maxUrls.description: Cost cap. Each URL x device is one billed audit.

strategy.title: Device
strategy.description: mobile uses Lighthouse's default mobile emulation and throttling; desktop uses the desktop preset. both = two audits (and two charges) per URL.

categories.title: Lighthouse categories
categories.description: Categories to score. Core Web Vitals come from the performance category.

maxOpportunities.title: Top improvement suggestions per page
maxOpportunities.description: How many Lighthouse opportunities (sorted by estimated savings) to include.

engine.title: Audit engine
engine.description: local = Lighthouse runs inside this Actor (no key needed, billed as url-audited-local). The Actor default memory is 4096 MB, which local mode needs. psi = use your own PageSpeed Insights API key (cheaper, includes Chrome UX Report field data when available, billed as url-audited). For psi, set the run memory to 1 GB (1024 MB) to cut cost. Local mode still requires at least 4096 MB.

psiApiKey.title: Your PageSpeed Insights API key
psiApiKey.description: Only used when engine = psi. Stored encrypted, never logged, never written to output, used only for this run's requests to Google.

perUrlTimeoutSecs.title: Timeout per audit (seconds)
perUrlTimeoutSecs.description: Audits that take longer are recorded as TIMEOUT and not billed.

retries.title: Retries per failed audit
retries.description: How many times to retry an audit that failed for a temporary reason (timeout, Chrome crash).

precheckReachability.title: Pre-check that URLs respond
precheckReachability.description: Send a quick HTTP request before launching Lighthouse; unreachable URLs are skipped (not billed) with an error code.
